guide: Qualys API (VM and PA) User Guide

operations.name: List hosts - V6

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Makes a Host List request.

parameters.name: os_hostname
parameters.description: Includes the operating-system hostname in XML output when set to 1.

parameters.name: echo_request
parameters.description: Echoes submitted input parameters in the XML response when set to 1.

parameters.name: show_asset_id
parameters.description: Includes the asset ID for each scanned host when set to 1.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Controls how much host information is returned; Basic is the default and None returns only the host ID.

parameters.name: os_pattern
parameters.description: Filters hosts by a URL-encoded PCRE operating-system expression; use %5E%24 to match an empty string.

parameters.name: truncation_limit
parameters.description: Sets the maximum records per page. Default is 1000; 0 disables pagination and can produce a very large response.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated IPv4 addresses, ranges, or CIDR values.

parameters.name: ipv6
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated IPv6 addresses. It cannot be combined with other target filters.

parameters.name: ag_ids
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated asset-group IDs or ID ranges.

parameters.name: ag_titles
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated strings in asset-group titles.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated host IDs or host-ID ranges.

parameters.name: id_min
parameters.description: Returns hosts with IDs at or above this value.

parameters.name: id_max
parameters.description: Returns hosts with IDs at or below this value.

parameters.name: network_ids
parameters.description: Filters by custom network IDs when Network Support is enabled.

parameters.name: compliance_enabled
parameters.description: Filters for non-compliance hosts (0) or Policy Compliance hosts (1); requires the appropriate module and permissions.

parameters.name: cloud_agent_activationkey
parameters.description: Includes Cloud Agent activation-key and activation-title tags for applicable assets when set to 1.

parameters.name: no_vm_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns hosts not scanned for vulnerabilities since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: no_compliance_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns compliance hosts not scanned since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns hosts targeted by a vulnerability scan since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: compliance_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns hosts targeted by a compliance scan since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_processed_before
parameters.description: Returns hosts with vulnerability results processed on or before the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_processed_after
parameters.description: Returns hosts with vulnerability results processed after the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_scan_date_before
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a vulnerability scan end date on or before the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_scan_date_after
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a vulnerability scan end date after the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_auth_scan_date_before
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a successful authenticated vulnerability scan ending on or before the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: vm_auth_scan_date_after
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a successful authenticated vulnerability scan ending after the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: pc_auth_success_date_before
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a successful compliance scan ending on or before the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: pc_auth_success_date_after
parameters.description: Returns hosts with a successful compliance scan ending after the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: scap_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns hosts targeted by a SCAP scan since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: no_scap_scan_since
parameters.description: Returns hosts not scanned for SCAP since the supplied UTC date/time.

parameters.name: use_tags
parameters.description: Enables tag-based host selection. Leave 0 to select by IP address or asset group.

parameters.name: tag_set_by
parameters.description: Chooses whether the tag set is identified by tag IDs or tag names.

parameters.name: tag_include_selector
parameters.description: Requires a host to match any or all selected inclusion tags.

parameters.name: tag_exclude_selector
parameters.description: Excludes a host that matches any or all selected exclusion tags.

parameters.name: tag_set_include
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag IDs or names identifying hosts to include.

parameters.name: tag_set_exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag IDs or names identifying hosts to exclude.

parameters.name: show_tags
parameters.description: Includes associated asset tags in the XML output when set to 1.

parameters.name: show_ars
parameters.description: Includes the Asset Risk Score (ARS) in output. Qualys advises moving to TruRisk parameters.

parameters.name: ars_min
parameters.description: Filters for assets at or above this ARS value; requires show_ars=1 and must be lower than ars_max.

parameters.name: ars_max
parameters.description: Filters for assets at or below this ARS value; requires show_ars=1 and must exceed ars_min.

parameters.name: show_ars_factors
parameters.description: Includes ARS contributing factors in output when set to 1.

parameters.name: show_trurisk
parameters.description: Includes the TruRisk score in output when set to 1.

parameters.name: trurisk_min
parameters.description: Filters for assets at or above this TruRisk score; requires show_trurisk=1 and must be lower than trurisk_max.

parameters.name: trurisk_max
parameters.description: Filters for assets at or below this TruRisk score; requires show_trurisk=1 and must exceed trurisk_min.

parameters.name: show_trurisk_factors
parameters.description: Includes TruRisk contributing factors in output when set to 1.

parameters.name: host_metadata
parameters.description: Returns cloud metadata for all cloud providers or the selected provider while listing all assets.

parameters.name: host_metadata_fields
parameters.description: Limits cloud metadata output to the specified attributes.

parameters.name: show_cloud_tags
parameters.description: Includes cloud-provider tags for each scanned host when set to 1.

parameters.name: cloud_tag_fields
parameters.description: Limits cloud-tag output to specified tags or tag-name:value combinations.
